items.title: Productboard
items.description: Product management platform focused on B2B insight collection, prioritization, and roadmapping with customer portal. Strong integrations with Salesforce, Jira, and Zendesk.

items.title: Amplitude
items.description: Product analytics platform for understanding B2B user behavior. Behavioral cohorts, funnel analysis, retention curves, and feature adoption tracking for enterprise products.

items.title: Pendo
items.description: Product adoption and digital adoption platform. In-app guides, NPS surveys, and feature engagement analytics. Strong B2B enterprise feature set including multi-product views.

items.title: Stripe Billing
items.description: B2B subscription management and billing platform. Supports usage-based pricing, tiered plans, invoicing, and revenue recognition. Essential for any B2B SaaS product.

items.title: Hotjar
items.description: Experience analytics tool with session recordings, heatmaps, and surveys. Useful for B2B user research and understanding how enterprise users interact with complex interfaces.

items.title: LaunchDarkly
items.description: Feature management platform for B2B products. Gradual rollouts, A/B testing, targeting by customer segment, and kill switches for enterprise reliability.

items.title: Linear
items.description: Issue tracking and project management for product teams. Keyboard-first, fast, and developer-friendly. Strong API for automation and integrations with GitHub/GitLab.

items.title: Retool
items.description: Low-code platform for building internal B2B tools. Connect to any database or API to create admin panels, customer dashboards, and internal CRUD apps quickly.

items.title: Canny
items.description: Customer feedback management platform for B2B. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests with public or private roadmaps. Integrates with Intercom, Zendesk, and Slack.

items.title: Segment (Twilio Segment)
items.description: Customer data platform for B2B. Collect, unify, and route customer data across analytics, marketing, and product tools. Essential for building a single view of the enterprise customer.
